vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean up

reasons.en: calls richer than puts by +2.5 vol pts vs peers — strong informed bullish lean
reasons.zh: 看涨比看跌贵 +2.5 个波动点（相对同业） — 知情资金强烈偏多

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

The treatment showed clinical regression in 83.1% of assessed lesions across three patients, including 85.1% regression in non-injected lesions suggesting systemic immune activity. KB113 was well tolerated, and the company has begun FDA discussions on advanced clinical development.

Ross Stores plans 115 store openings with 13% Q2 sales growth, Roku's advertising revenue climbed 24.8%, APA Corp benefits from cost savings and long-term growth projects, Corcept Therapeutics sees strong drug demand with recent FDA approvals, and Halozyme generates royalties from pharma collaborations.

reasons.en: deep long-gamma (+12.0% over the flip) — dealers pin & fade breakouts

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -12.0 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -12.0 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Obesity Clinical Trial and Competitive Landscape Surges as 200+ Companies Advance Next-Generation Therapies | DelveInsight
top.summary: Over 200 companies are advancing next-generation obesity therapies, with more than 30 drugs in late-stage development and 180+ in mid and early stages. Key players include Eli Lilly, Novo Nordisk, Viking Therapeutics, and Roche, developing innovative mechanisms like dual GLP-1/GIP receptor agonists and triple hormone receptor agonists. Recent approvals include Novo Nordisk's oral Wegovy formulation and Eli Lilly's orforglipron, while multiple Phase III trials show promising weight loss results.

top.title: Viking Therapeutics Starts Phase III Development of Obesity Pill
top.summary: Viking Therapeutics announced the initiation of the SUNRISE phase III program to evaluate its oral VK2735 formulation for obesity treatment. The program consists of two studies targeting 560 adults each, with and without type 2 diabetes. Phase II results showed up to 12.2% mean weight loss at the highest dose versus 1.3% with placebo. Despite positive developments, VKTX stock declined 4.4% on the announcement day and is down 27.6% year-to-date.

top.title: Can Nektar's Pipeline Progress Create Long-Term Value Amid Rivalry?
top.summary: Nektar Therapeutics (NKTR) initiated two Phase III studies (ZENITH AD-1 and ZENITH AD-2) for rezpeg in atopic dermatitis in July 2026, with top-line data expected mid-2028. The company plans Phase III studies for alopecia areata in early 2027 and expects Type I diabetes data in 2027. Rezpeg, a self-administered injection that activates regulatory T-cells, faces competition from established players like Sanofi/Regeneron's Dupixent. NKTR trades at a valuation discount to the industry with a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold) rating.

However, revenues of $7.17B missed expectations of $7.19B, causing shares to decline 4.5% in pre-market trading. Positive drivers included record core net new assets of $190.4B (up 38%), higher net interest revenues (+14% to $3.48B), and increased trading revenues (+16% to $1.16B). Headwinds included rising expenses (+9% to $3.24B) and concerns about revenue sustainability amid uncertain interest rates.

top.summary: Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD) announced positive nine-month results from the AGILITY trial for its Revello Vascular Covered Stent in treating iliac artery disease. gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -4.7 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -4.7 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Stock Market News for Oct 16, 2026
top.summary: Wall Street rallied on Thursday with all three major indexes closing in the green, driven by a rotation into defensive sectors like healthcare, materials, and financials. Investors shifted away from debt-sensitive AI and technology stocks as Treasury yields fell. The Dow Jones jumped 1.1%, the S&P 500 added 0.3%, and the Nasdaq gained 0.1%, while economic data showed mixed signals with jobless claims rising slightly and PPI inflation at 1.3%.

top.title: NEM to Report Q3 Earnings: What's in the Offing for the Stock?
top.summary: Newmont Corporation is set to report Q3 2026 results on October 22, with analysts predicting an earnings beat. While higher realized gold prices (~$4,428/oz, up 25% YoY) are expected to boost revenues and margins, weaker production (down 13% YoY to 1.29M oz) and significantly higher costs (AISC up 25.2% YoY to $1,961/oz) are likely to offset pricing gains. The company faces headwinds from strategic divestitures, lower output from key mines, and elevated sustaining capital spending.

top.summary: Akamai Technologies and Arista Networks are both capitalizing on AI infrastructure expansion, but with different approaches. Akamai focuses on edge computing and cloud infrastructure with $2.8B in commitments, while Arista leads in data center networking with $3.6B expected AI revenue in 2026. top.title: Inflation Pressures Rise as Services Activity Weakens
top.summary: Q3 earnings season shows mixed results with early reports tracking modestly below recent quarters. Import prices hit their highest rate since May at +1.1%, signaling persistent inflation concerns. The New York Fed's October Services report plummeted to -20.7, marking the sharpest decline since March. Key earnings this week included Travelers beating expectations with a +29.84% earnings surprise, while regional banks showed modest beats. Major tech and consumer companies including Netflix, Tesla, Meta, and General Motors are set to report next week.

top.title: First Week of Q3 Earnings in the Books
top.summary: Q3 earnings season shows mixed results with early reports tracking modestly below recent quarters. Import prices rose higher than expected in September (+1.1% vs +0.8% expected), marking the highest rate since May. The NY Fed's October Services report came in significantly below expectations at -20.7 vs -4.1 expected, hitting its lowest level since March. Among earnings reports, Travelers beat estimates by 29.84%, while regional banks Regions Financial, Citizens Financial Group, and M&T Bank also beat earnings expectations. Major tech earnings from Netflix, Tesla, Meta, and others are expected next week.

top.title: OPKO Health to Sell Select BioReference Assets to Labcorp for $722M
top.summary: OPKO Health announced an agreement to sell select BioReference assets to Labcorp for $722 million in cash plus up to $150 million in earnouts. The deal includes the 4Kscore Test, specialty testing operations, and over 80 patient service centers. OPKO aims to focus on its biopharmaceutical business, while Labcorp expects $250 million in first-year revenue from the acquisition. OPK stock rose 17.5% following the announcement.

top.title: BD's Revello Stent Shows Strong AGILITY Trial Results for PAD Patients
top.summary: Becton, Dickinson and Company (BD) announced positive nine-month results from the AGILITY trial for its Revello Vascular Covered Stent in treating iliac artery disease. The trial met its primary endpoint with a 2.8% failure rate, 97.2% primary patency, and 98.3% freedom from clinically driven target lesion revascularization. The device remains investigational in the U.S. with clinical follow-up continuing through 36 months. The global iliac stent market is projected to grow at a 6.5% CAGR through 2033.

top.title: Doximity Deepens U.S. News Alliance to Improve Patient Access to Care
top.summary: Doximity announced an extension of its 13-year partnership with U.S. News & World Report, continuing to provide physician data for Doctor Finder, Patient Connect appointment-booking tools, and Expert Opinion surveys for hospital rankings. The partnership leverages Doximity's network of 3+ million medical professionals to connect patients with healthcare providers. Despite the news, DOCS stock declined 2.1% following the announcement and is down 32.4% year-to-date.

reasons.en: long-gamma — dealer hedging dampens the move
reasons.zh: 多头 Gamma — 做市商对冲抑制波动

reasons.en: within ~1σ of the call wall (25) — mechanical resistance overhead

reasons.en: armed at the upper gamma band — a close above releases the move up

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility is already elevated — realized vol sits in the top fifth of the past year, so the move is underway, not loading. This is the opposite of a coiled squeeze: the quiet entry is already gone. A late / heads-up read, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动率已处于高位 — 实现波动率位于过去一年前五分之一，行情已在进行，而非蓄势。这与压缩蓄势相反：安静的入场点已过。属偏晚的提示读数，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -5.0 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -5.0 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.summary: Roche announced FDA approval of Enspryng (satralizumab) for thyroid eye disease (TED), marking the drug's second approved indication. top.title: FDA approves Roche’s Enspryng, a first-in-class IL-6R inhibitor, as the first and only at-home subcutaneous treatment option for thyroid eye disease (TED)
top.summary: The FDA has approved Roche's Enspryng (satralizumab) as the first at-home subcutaneous treatment for thyroid eye disease (TED). The approval was based on Phase III SatraGO-1 and -2 studies, with SatraGO-2 demonstrating significant reductions in eye bulging (proptosis) and improvements in double vision (diplopia). Enspryng is an IL-6R inhibitor using novel recycling antibody technology and represents the second indication for the drug, following its 2020 approval for neuromyelitis optica spectrum disorder (NMOSD).

Asia-Pacific leads regional growth at 7.43% CAGR, followed by North America and Europe.

gex_confirm.caveat: Dealer-gamma confirmer — context for HOW the next move behaves, not a name pick. Dealer sign is an assumption (fragile for single names) and the feed is delayed EOD. It can only lower conviction, never create a buy.
gex_confirm.caveat_zh: 做市商 Gamma 确认器 — 用于判断下一步波动的“方式”，并非选股。做市商方向为假设（对个股较脆弱），数据为延迟收盘。它只能降低信心，绝不制造买入信号。

vol_squeeze.caveat: Volatility compression read — a TIMING context, not a direction call. A durable squeeze means a larger move is loading; which way is unconfirmed until price breaks the box (on volume). Moderate edge, never a standalone signal.
vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options neutral
iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。

top.title: Viking Therapeutics Starts Phase III Development of Obesity Pill

Despite positive developments, VKTX stock declined 4.4% on the announcement day and is down 27.6% year-to-date.

vol_squeeze.caveat_zh: 波动压缩读数 — 属择时背景，并非方向判断。持续的压缩意味着更大的波动正在蓄势；方向要等价格放量突破压缩箱后才确认。中等效力，绝非独立信号。

iv_spread_confirm.label: Options lean down

reasons.en: puts richer than calls by -4.4 vol pts vs peers — protection strongly bid
reasons.zh: 看跌比看涨贵 -4.4 个波动点（相对同业） — 保护性看跌被大力买入

iv_spread_confirm.caveat: Cremers-Weinbaum call−put IV spread (matched strikes, ~30d, OI-weighted). Calls richer than puts = informed bullish lean; puts richer = protection bid. A CROSS-SECTIONAL context read — dividends/borrow can bias the level, the feed is delayed EOD, and it is DISPLAY-ONLY until the forward-IC gate validates. It can amplify or caution a long the price thesis already likes, never create a buy.
iv_spread_confirm.caveat_zh: Cremers-Weinbaum 看涨−看跌隐含波动率价差（同行权价配对，约30天，按未平仓量加权）。看涨比看跌更贵 = 知情资金偏多；看跌更贵 = 买入保护。这是横截面参考读数 — 股息/借券成本会扰动水平，数据为延迟收盘，且在前瞻IC验证通过前仅作展示。它只能放大或警示价格逻辑本已看好的多头，绝不制造买入信号。
